svg.title: Muqarnas: elevation
svg.desc: Elevation of a muqarnas hood: rows of small pointed niche-cells, each tier corbelled out over the one below with pendants at the steps, rising to a single crown cell, so a square frame is roofed by a cascade of tiny vaults. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
